title: The New Scott Addict Gravel Leans in to Modern Gravel Racing with Big Tires and Stable Geometry
content:
While the prototype 32-inch version of Scott's new gravel bike stays in development, the brand has a progressive new race bike that brings big changes to a key gravel race frame.

Read the full article at The New Scott Addict Gravel Leans in to Modern Gravel Racing with Big Tires and Stable Geometry on Velo.
author: Logan Jones-Wilkins
